title: Antigravity Audit Findings
description: Pass to the runtime as --json-schema for read-only audits. Forcing file+line+quote on every verdict is what stops a model from returning a correct judgement anchored to an invented citation. agy treats the schema as a strong instruction, not a validator: observed output kept every required field but also added its own toolAction/toolSummary keys, so the top level stays open.

summary.description: What was audited and what the reviewer concluded overall.

id.description: Stable identifier for the claim under audit.

file.description: Repository-relative path actually opened. null only when verdict is unverifiable.

line.description: 1-indexed line the quote came from. null only when verdict is unverifiable.

quote.description: Verbatim source text at file:line. null only when verdict is unverifiable.

notOpened.description: Files the audit could not open, with the reason. An empty audit must say so here rather than reporting everything as unverifiable.
